## Historical audit — S0054

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/quota_restored_20261103/retired/results/r1/generic_rsi/C1/test/commons_16007442/trajectory.jsonl`.

| Evidence | Observation |
|---|---|
| JSONL line 1, `model_request`, characters [0,10095) | The requested goal was to reconstruct a 512 × 388 indoor RGB reference using separate SceneAct/Blender meshes, matching viewpoint, framing, occlusion and materials. The prompt required a runnable program and render-based review; the reference image itself is not visible in this audit. These are requested goals, not achieved results. |
| Line 2, student `codex_session`, [0,2620) | One fresh, read-only CLI session received a staged image path. It failed with exit code 1 after approximately 8.4 seconds; the record reports zero tool calls and does not expose all underlying inference rounds. |
| Lines 3–4, `model_error` and `scene_error`, respectively [0,542) and [0,1605) | The runtime propagated the failed student exit. A stderr path is named, but its contents are not included, so the underlying cause is unknown. |

**Actual work and validation.** No student program, scene modification, Blender execution, render, comparison, or submitted build is visible. The record therefore does not establish whether the reference contains particular objects, or whether any reconstruction has multiple objects, appropriate materials or textures, connected parts, correct poses, or suitable camera and lighting. No render is available to diagnose image or rendering issues. The image path and task instructions are not visual verification.

**Teacher and exploration.** No teacher input, detection, diagnosis, proposed update, or student adoption appears in the supplied trajectory. No autonomous tool exploration is recorded; the failed CLI session reports zero tool calls. The system prompt's reconstruction guidance is task instruction, not evidence that a teacher intervention was received or executed.

**Outcome and lessons.** This is a **technical interruption**, not demonstrated algorithm failure, partial geometric correctness, formal success, or an established empty patch. The transferable procedural lesson is that a failed model session cannot validate a reconstruction; a successful execution and inspectable render would be needed. The task-specific cause of the exit and the scene's actual contents remain unresolved; the referenced stderr and image are not supplied as observations.
